evidence.reason: qemu_command interpolates the resolved run directory directly into -drive option strings. QEMU's option parser treats commas as delimiters inside file=..., so a state directory such as probe,local produces malformed drive arguments and the VM launch fails even though preparation succeeded. The supplied code neither escapes commas (QEMU requires doubled commas in filenames) nor rejects comma-containing state paths. This is a routine implementation defect in existing behavior, not a new requirement.
